name: Support reply: ready to send?
description: Drafted replies from our customer-support agent at Fernway (an outdoor-gear store), judged the way our support lead reviews them before they go out. The lead sends replies that solve the customer's actual problem, give a concrete next step or timeline, and sound like a calm human. They push back on drafts that grovel or over-apologize, run long, blame the customer, or promise things support cannot guarantee (refunds outside policy, delivery dates, exceptions). Items are {customer, reply}.

labels.description: Right substance, but needs a light edit (tone, length, a missing detail) before sending.
Wrong or risky: misses the problem, promises what we cannot deliver, or blames the customer. Start over.

rubric_v1.prompt: Does the reply directly address the customer's actual question or problem?

criteria.true: Engages with the specific issue the customer raised.
criteria.false: Generic, off-topic, or ignores the real issue.

rubric_v1.prompt: Does the reply give the customer a concrete next step or timeline?

criteria.true: States what happens next, what the customer should do, or when.
criteria.false: Leaves the customer without a clear next step.

rubric_v1.prompt: Which best describes the tone of the reply?
How appropriate is the reply's length for what the customer asked?
criteria: Far too short to be useful
Far too long, padded or rambling

rubric_v1.prompt: Does the reply blame or lecture the customer?

criteria.true: Implies the problem is the customer's fault or lectures them.

added_in_v2.prompt: Does the reply promise an outcome support cannot guarantee (a refund outside policy, a specific delivery date, an exception, a replacement before inspection)?

criteria.true: Makes a commitment support cannot be sure it can keep.
criteria.false: Only commits to things support controls, or hedges appropriately.

examples.label: send
examples.customer: My order #4471 says delivered but there's nothing on my porch.
examples.reply: Thanks for letting us know. Carriers sometimes mark packages delivered a day early, so please check again tomorrow and look around side doors or with neighbors. If it hasn't turned up by Thursday, reply here and I'll open a carrier trace and send a replacement or refund, whichever you prefer.

examples.label: send
examples.customer: Can I return boots I've worn outside once? They hurt my heels.
examples.reply: Yes. Our 60-day comfort guarantee covers boots worn outdoors, so you can return or exchange them. I've emailed you a prepaid label; drop the box at any UPS location and we'll process the refund within 3 business days of it arriving.

examples.label: send
examples.customer: What's the difference between the Ridge 40 and Ridge 50 packs besides size?
examples.reply: Good question. The Ridge 50 adds a removable lid pocket, a stiffer frame sheet rated to about 40 lb, and hip-belt pockets on both sides. The Ridge 40 is 300 g lighter and fits better on shorter torsos. If you're mostly doing overnights under 30 lb, the 40 is the better pick.

examples.label: send
examples.customer: I was charged twice for the same order.
examples.reply: I can see both charges on order #5120. The second one is a pending authorization that your bank will release automatically within 3-5 business days, so you won't pay twice. If it's still there next Monday, reply with a screenshot of your statement and I'll get our payments team to reverse it.

examples.label: send
examples.customer: Do you ship to Canada?
examples.reply: We do. Shipping to Canada is a flat $18 and usually takes 5-8 business days. Duties are included at checkout, so there's nothing extra to pay on delivery.

examples.label: send
examples.customer: The zipper on my jacket broke after two months.
examples.reply: That shouldn't happen after two months, and it's covered by our warranty. Send a photo of the zipper and your order number and we'll either ship a replacement jacket or arrange a free repair. Most replacements go out within two business days of the photo.

examples.label: send
examples.customer: How do I clean my down sleeping bag?
examples.reply: Use a front-loading machine on a gentle cycle with a down-specific wash, then tumble dry on low with two or three clean tennis balls to break up clumps. It can take 2-3 hours to dry fully. Make sure there are no damp clumps left before storing it loose.

examples.label: send
examples.customer: Can I change the shipping address? I just placed the order.
examples.reply: Yes, it hasn't shipped yet. Reply with the new address and I'll update it right away; you'll get a confirmation email once it's changed.

examples.label: send
examples.customer: Is the Alpen tent actually waterproof or just water resistant?
examples.reply: It's waterproof: the fly is rated to 3,000 mm with fully taped seams, which holds up in sustained heavy rain. The floor is 5,000 mm. Pitching the fly taut and using all the guy-outs makes the biggest difference in a storm.

examples.label: edit
examples.customer: My order hasn't shipped and it's been a week.
examples.reply: I'm so sorry, I truly apologize for this delay, and I'm really sorry for any frustration this has caused you. We sincerely apologize. Your order is waiting on the blue colorway, which arrives at our warehouse Friday, and it will ship Monday.

examples.label: edit
examples.customer: Can I return boots I've worn outside once?
examples.reply: Hi there! Thank you so much for reaching out to Fernway, we absolutely love hearing from our customers and we're always happy to help with any questions about our products, policies, and services. Regarding your question about returns, I'm pleased to share that our 60-day comfort guarantee covers boots worn outdoors, which means you can return them. Our team is committed to making sure you're happy with every purchase, and we really appreciate your business and loyalty. I've sent a prepaid label to your email.

examples.label: edit
examples.customer: The strap on my backpack ripped.
examples.reply: That's covered by our warranty. Please send a photo.

examples.label: edit
examples.customer: I was charged twice.
examples.reply: Sorry about that! Sometimes this happens with banks. It should go away eventually.

examples.label: edit
examples.customer: What's your return window?
examples.reply: Our return window is 60 days from delivery for unused items, and our comfort guarantee extends that to worn footwear and apparel within the same 60 days. Refunds go back to the original payment method. I deeply apologize for any confusion our website may have caused, and I'm so sorry if the policy wasn't clear, we really regret that.

Here is some additional information about our shipping partners, warehouse locations in Nevada and Ohio, carbon-offset program, packaging materials which are 90% recycled, and our holiday shipping cutoffs, which are listed on our shipping page along with international rates and duties for 42 countries.

examples.label: edit
examples.customer: Do the Ridge packs come with a rain cover?
examples.reply: Great question! We get this one a lot, and it's a really important consideration for anyone heading into wet climates like the Pacific Northwest, where we're based and where it rains about 150 days a year. Rain covers protect your gear, extend the life of the pack fabric, and keep your sleeping bag dry. The Ridge packs don't include a rain cover, but the Ridge cover in M fits both models and costs $24, and it has reflective trim, a drawcord, and a stuff sack, and comes in three colors.
